name: Mosquito ~Mosquito no Inbou~
source:
Hero works as a bartender, but recently a special mosquito has appeared in his life. He can control that mosquito and see from his eyes. Now he uses that ability to spy on the bar clients from very bold angles.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名调酒师，但最近一只特殊的蚊子出现在了他的生活中。他可以控制那只蚊子并通过它的眼睛观察。现在他利用这种能力从极其大胆的角度偷窥酒吧的顾客。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
